analysis:
The PR changes documentation only: docs/provider/cli-reference.md and docs/provider/sandboxes.md. The sandboxes.md patch adds a pre-step, `darkbloom waitlist sandbox`, and states that `darkbloom sandbox setup` installs nothing until the account is approved. It also adds troubleshooting entries for the waitlist, login, revoked-access and unreachable-waitlist cases. The cli-reference.md head excerpts I reviewed (lines 2869-3303) show only context. The patch excerpt shows the `sandbox` row now saying setup requires waitlist approval and a new `darkbloom-waitlist` anchor. The reviewed units contain no code or config changes, so no new security control is changed.

Relevant boundaries are TB-013 (CLI to sandbox installer/add-on, T-061) and TB-012 (add-on hold). The docs claim the waitlist sends nothing about the Mac and that setup fails closed (installs nothing) when approval is unknown or the waitlist is unreachable. Those claims are behavioral and the implementation was not supplied. The waitlist command section (head lines 1635-1727 of cli-reference.md) falls in a different unit, outside what I examined, so I cannot verify those claims. Nothing in the visible text weakens the installer download-and-run integrity controls described in T-061, and the approval gate is advisory UX, not an auth control in the supplied evidence.

Remaining question for integration: confirm that the waitlist gating code and its request contents, as documented, match the implementation, and that the installer authenticity/verification story in TB-013/T-061 is unchanged. This needs no deeper review from the docs alone.
